deals.description: Only until the end of September! 🍒🎀 A little Lancôme surprise in Vienna Adlerhof has a limited-edition cherry dessert in collaboration with Lancôme — and it’s actually really good! It costs €8.50 and has a sweet & slightly sour cherry filling inside 🍒 And the best part? With the dessert you get a mini Lancôme perfume for free 🎀 You can smell the different fragrances there and choose your favorite. You also get 30% off at Lancôme with the offer ✨ 📍 Adlerhof, Vienna 💶 €8.50 🗓️ Available until the end of September Save this for your next Vienna café date 🎀🍰 Not an ad — just a cute Vienna find 🤍 ".
